net_change_vs_prior.note: 6 prior findings fixed (AUTH-009 rate-limit, AUTH-011 case-insensitive, AUTH-012 OAuth TTL, AUTH-014 crypto.randomBytes, STRIPE-006 team rollover, DESIGN-017 SiteNav hex). 19 new findings surfaced, mostly in auth (JWT-in-URL, deleted-user session) and billing (solo double-hours, team auto-topup loop).

findings.description: verifyToken() does not enforce payload.type === 'access' — add type check so refresh/other tokens are rejected by all middleware
createToken() accepts any payload without type claim validation — add type allowlist in createToken()
requireAdmin() checks role === 'admin' but role is never set (always 'user') — admin access is completely broken for all users via this middleware; change to check is_admin boolean
Cookie domain hardcoded to '.cariara.com' in setSSOCookie/clearSSOCookie — add COOKIE_DOMAIN env support for staging
Bearer token parsing inconsistent: shared-auth and lumora use slice(7), ascend uses split(' ')[1] — standardize across all middlewares
OWNER_EMAILS auto-applies is_admin=true at every startup but never clears it when email removed from env — manage admin grant via DB migration, not env auto-grant
Both OWNER_EMAILS and ADMIN_EMAILS supported in 4 separate files with no deprecation path — standardize on one variable
Refresh endpoint uses ignoreExpiration without absolute max-age bound on token iat — a stolen unrevoked token refreshes forever; add 90-day floor on iat
CORS allows origins matching 'ascend'/'capra'/'camora'/'chundu' as substring — an attacker can register evil-ascend.vercel.app and send credentialed requests; switch to explicit allowlist
verifyToken() has no algorithm whitelist — add algorithms: ['HS256'] to jwt.verify options
tryJwtAuth() does not check is_active — deactivated user's token authenticates through ascend; lumora is fixed but ascend is not
JWT accepted via ?token= query param for SSE compat, but applied to all routes — tokens appear in server access logs and Referer headers; restrict to SSE endpoints only
tryJwtAuth() does not reject JWT for deleted users — account deletion leaves valid tokens active until 30-day expiry; add user-existence check after token verify
adminSecret !== expectedSecret is not constant-time — use safeEq() (already defined line 29) to prevent timing side-channel on ADMIN_SECRET
Login handler sends real user IP to ipapi.co on every OAuth flow without consent — add privacy notice or remove IP geolocation lookup
/me mints a fresh 30-day access token on every call — stolen sessions never expire via TTL for active users; consider capping re-issuance to once per N hours
teamPriceCents() uses linear formula (seats*20-1)*100 — dead export (zero callers) but teamService.js is source referenced by /prices API; pricing page shows wrong amount vs what Stripe charges

/prices API exposes price_per_seat_cents: 2000 / flat_discount_cents: 100 (formula seats*2000-100) but checkout uses tiered computeTeamPriceCents — for 25 seats frontend shows $499, Stripe charges $249; material price misrepresentation
Hardcoded plan type check missing 'lifetime' — lifetime subscribers treated as free users; import PAID_PLAN_TYPES from @camora/shared-db/plans
PAID_PLAN_TYPES redeclared locally instead of imported from lib/plans.js — will silently drift if new plan type added to shared source
Comment 'Helper formula: amount_cents = seats * 2000 - 100' is factually wrong (computeTeamPriceCents(10)=$99, formula gives $199) — remove comment, expose actual tiered formula, fix /prices response

handleInvoicePaid inserts ai_hour_topups per renewal but checkPersonalHourBudget also adds hardcoded PERSONAL_HOUR_BUDGETS.hours — solo subscribers get double hours from period 2 onward (monthly: 4h instead of 2h)
Sync card failure clears ascend_subscriptions.auto_topup_pack but team auto-topup lives in teams.auto_topup_pack — UPDATE is a no-op for teams; team retries loop on every budget exhaustion
PRICE_TO_PLAN[STRIPE_PRICES.TEAM] compiles to PRICE_TO_PLAN['undefined']='team' — works by JS key-coercion coincidence; use explicit metadata.type check instead
Config comment says 'seats × 20 − 1' formula but billing.js uses tiered formula — remove or update to reflect actual checkout math
Comment 'handleCheckoutComplete already grants first period's hours' is false — period 1 hours come from hardcoded PERSONAL_HOUR_BUDGETS constant; if zeroed out, new subscribers start with 0 hours
Admin endpoints use apiLimiter (60 req/min) not paymentLimiter; Stripe-refund admin endpoint in particular should have a stricter rate limit
Math.random() for multipart boundary generation (non-security, acceptable — boundary never sent to client)
Math.random() for quiz question shuffle (non-security, acceptable — Fisher-Yates UI shuffle only)
POST /admin/refund-requests/:id/approve uses apiLimiter (60 req/min) instead of paymentLimiter (20 req/hr) — a compromised admin credential can trigger rapid real Stripe refunds
/api/v1/mcq mounted without hourBudgetGate — a past_due/canceled user with valid JWT can trigger Gemini API calls at 20 req/min on cache misses
lumora-backend transcription route has no hourBudgetGate — only legacy per-question checkLimit; users can transcribe beyond AI-hours pool when hitting lumora directly
Root ErrorBoundary.onError only calls console.error — no Sentry/remote sink wired; production render crashes are invisible to ops
submitAnswer() catch block silently discards AI evaluation errors with no logging — repeated model failures go unreported to ops
Function named generateWithClaude instantiates Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) not Claude — stale name from provider migration causes incident triage confusion
Missing SiteNav on public /flyer page — add SiteNav for brand consistency (feedback_nav_redirect_rules)
cyan-500 (#22D3EE) in hero heading gradient — replace with emerald/var(--accent) per Lumora palette rules (feedback_lumora_sharp_palette)
cyan-500 (#22D3EE) in CTA gradient (second occurrence) — replace with emerald per Lumora palette rules
text-cyan-200 in step labels — replace with emerald palette color
rgba(255,255,255,0.75) as tab text color — not WCAG-failing (dark bg) but still a raw literal; use design token (feedback_no_white_on_white)
Hardcoded hex #10b981 for easy difficulty — replace with CSS design token var(--cam-success)
Hardcoded hex #f59e0b for medium difficulty — replace with CSS design token var(--cam-warning)
Hardcoded hex #ef4444 for hard difficulty — replace with CSS design token var(--color-error)
Hex values now use CSS-var-with-hex-fallback (var(--color-error, #ef4444)) — improvement but fallback literals remain; remove hex fallbacks once tokens are wired
Mixed CSS vars with hex fallbacks (#22c55e, #f59e0b, #ef4444) — remove hex fallbacks once tokens confirmed wired in all themes
Hardcoded hex #ef4444 for 'again' state — use design token
Hardcoded hex #f59e0b for 'hard' state — use design token
Hardcoded hex #22c55e for 'good' state — use design token
Hardcoded hex #3683DC for 'easy' state — use CSS var(--accent)
Company brand colors hardcoded as hex values — move to COMPANY_COLORS constants file
Hardcoded company brand hex colors (Google #4285F4, Amazon #FF9900, Meta #0668E1, Apple #555555, Microsoft #00A4EF, Netflix #E50914) — centralize in COMPANY_COLORS constants
Hardcoded #0047AB in !text-[#0047AB] and !border-[#0047AB]/40 Tailwind overrides for Cara/Playground chips — use CSS var(--cam-primary) or a new --cam-nav-chip-fg token
Public route /capra/landing renders without SiteNav — inconsistent with all other public-facing pages (feedback_nav_redirect_rules)
Four usages of hardcoded #0047AB in inline styles for button backgrounds, borders, and progress fills — route through design token
